_note: Two Baidu photos of the terminal from the air and the departures hall, alongside an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

tfu-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，成都天府国际机场（TFU）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
tfu-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Chengdu Tianfu International Airport (TFU) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

tfu-baidu-1.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰成都天府机场：两座弧形航站楼向两侧伸展如双翼，中央是绿植环绕的圆形枢纽。
tfu-baidu-1.webp.en: An aerial view of Chengdu Tianfu, its two curving terminal wings reaching out either side of a circular hub ringed with greenery.

tfu-baidu-2.webp.zh: 国内出发安检口：红色横幅上写着机场名称，旅客拖着行李走向安检通道。
tfu-baidu-2.webp.en: The domestic departures security check, where a red banner carries the airport's name and passengers with luggage head for the lanes.
